name: Leisure Apex Hotel
description: Overnight stop on Lake Naivasha used on the road safari circuit, close to Hell's Gate National Park and Crescent Island.

name: Villa Leone Boutique Hotel
location: UN Avenue, Daisy Drive, Gigiri, 00620 Nairobi
description: Boutique hotel in Gigiri, Nairobi, used as a pre-/post-safari base.

name: Sarova Lion Hill Game Lodge
location: Lake Nakuru, Lake Nakuru National Park
description: Popular lodge inside the park on Lion Hill. | Highlights: Inside the park, Great views, Full spa | Room types: Chalet, Suite | Total rooms: 67

name: Enchoro Wildlife Camp
location: Near Oloolaimutia Gate, Masai Mara National Reserve
description: A budget-to-semi-luxury tented camp a few minutes' drive from Oloolaimutia gate, the closest entrance to the Maasai Mara National Reserve. Offers standard and superior canvas tents with private verandas, plus a restaurant, bar, and campground.

name: City Max Hotel
location: Nakuru town, near Lake Nakuru National Park
description: Overnight stop used on the Masai Mara – Lake Nakuru – Lake Naivasha road safari circuit.

name: Angata Ngorongoro Camp
location: Nyati Special Campsite, eastern rim of the Ngorongoro Crater
amenities: Bush lunch on the crater floor
description: A small tented camp on the eastern rim of the Ngorongoro Crater, close to Crater Lodge. It has eight guest tents, including a family unit made of two tents. Each tent has its own bathroom with a shower and flush toilet, and the beds can be set up as a king, twin or triple. Guests relax in the lounge tent with free Tanzanian coffee or tea, eat freshly cooked meals in the dining tent and gather around the campfire in the evening.

name: Angata Serengeti Camp
description: A large tented camp in Seronera, in the middle of the Serengeti, which makes game drives easy in almost every direction. It has twelve large guest tents, including a family unit made of two tents. Each tent has its own bathroom with a shower and flush toilet, and guests can ask for a king bed or two twin beds. There is a lounge tent with free Tanzanian coffee or tea, a dining tent serving freshly cooked meals, and a campfire in the evening. Seronera airstrip is about a 15 minute drive away.

name: Masai Mara Sopa Lodge
location: Oloolaimutia Hills, Masai Mara National Reserve
description: One of the first safari lodges built in the Masai Mara, set high on the slopes of the Oloolaimutia Hills with views over the gardens and the reserve. The lodge has 99 rooms in round cottages with conical roofs, and each room has an en-suite bathroom, mosquito nets, a safe and a veranda. Public areas include a restaurant, an outdoor boma dining area, a bar, a lounge and a swimming pool.

name: Lake Nakuru Sopa Lodge
amenities: Infinity swimming pool with pool bar
description: A hillside lodge on the western edge of the Great Rift Valley with views over Lake Nakuru and the national park. It has about 60 rooms, a lounge, bar and dining room with sheltered outdoor terraces, and an infinity swimming pool that looks out over the lake. Guests can go on game drives, guided nature walks and bird watching, and the park is home to both white and black rhinos.

name: Zebra Plains Mara Camp
location: Below Oldonyo Oloip Ridge, Masai Mara
description: A classic tented safari camp below the Oldonyo Oloip Ridge with wide views over the open plains of the Masai Mara. It has savannah facing and hillside facing rooms, plus family tents joined by a private lounge. Every room has its own bathroom with a hot shower, a study desk and a private verandah. The camp has a swimming pool, a spa, a bar lounge, indoor and outdoor lounges, campfire areas and three dining lounges, and a natural waterhole in front of the camp draws wildlife during the dry season.

name: Baobab Beach Resort
location: Diani Beach Road, Diani, Kwale County
amenities: Beach access to Diani and Galu
description: A large beach resort set in tropical gardens dotted with baobab trees, with access to both Diani Beach and the quieter Galu Beach. Rooms have a private balcony or terrace with sea, pool or garden views. The resort has swimming pools, a spa, restaurants and bars, and a wide choice of beach activities.

name: Sweetwaters Serena Camp
amenities: Heated swimming pool with pool bar
En-suite tents with veranda or balcony
description: A tented camp inside Ol Pejeta Conservancy on the Laikipia plains, set around a waterhole with views of Mount Kenya. It has about 56 en-suite tents, each with a private veranda or balcony and free Wi-Fi. The camp has the Rhino Restaurant, a waterhole bar, a heated swimming pool with a pool bar, a spa for massages and a recreation centre with table tennis, foosball, darts and a pool table. The conservancy is home to the Big Five and to the last two northern white rhinos.

name: Eagle Palace Hotel
description: A hotel in the centre of Nakuru town on Oginga Odinga Road, used as an overnight stop on Lake Nakuru game drive days. It has an on site restaurant open from 7 am to 10 pm, free parking, a terrace and conference facilities. Rooms have a private bathroom with a shower and tea and coffee making facilities.

name: Dove Nest Lodge
description: A lodge along North Kinangop Road near Lake Naivasha, with rooms and cottages that have flat screen TVs, tea making facilities and extra bedding for cool nights. Meals are served in the restaurant, in the gardens or on the private balcony, and there is a bush bar and an outdoor swimming pool. It is a quiet base for boat rides on the lake and walks on Crescent Island.

name: Nyati Safari Camp
description: A budget friendly camp right beside Kimana Gate at the edge of Amboseli National Park, with views of Mount Kilimanjaro. Guests stay in spacious tents or stone rooms with private toilets and hot and cold showers. The camp has a restaurant with a view of Kilimanjaro and free Wi-Fi.
